questions.scenario: Your favorite electronic gadget completely stops working. What is your first instinct?

options.text: Grab a screwdriver, open it up, and check the physical parts.
Search Google for error codes to find the exact software bug.
Check the wires, Wi-Fi connection, and power supply first.
Calculate if it's cheaper to fix it or just buy a better one.

questions.scenario: You are playing a futuristic Sci-Fi video game. What is your favorite thing to do?

options.text: Upgrading my robot's armor, weapons, and jetpack.
Hacking into computer terminals and solving number puzzles.
Setting up laser traps, security cameras, and base defenses.
Trading futuristic items with other players to become the richest.

questions.scenario: Your school asks you to build a 'Smart Dustbin' for a science fair. What is your role?

options.text: Building the mechanical lid that opens automatically.
Writing the code that tells the sensor when the bin is full.
Connecting all the batteries, cables, and sensors so they work perfectly.
Making a cool presentation to pitch the idea to the judges.

questions.scenario: When you look at your messy study desk, what bothers you the most?

options.text: Broken pens or rulers that need to be fixed or thrown out.
That things aren't sorted logically by subject or size.
The messy laptop charger and headphone wires tangled everywhere.
That it looks too ugly for me to record a good video or study comfortably.

questions.scenario: You get a brand new smartphone. What feature do you care about the most?

options.text: The physical build quality, glass strength, and camera lenses.
The processor speed and how much RAM it has for heavy tasks.
How fast it charges and how strong the 5G connection is.
The brand name and how cool it looks when I hold it.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube videos can you watch for hours without getting bored?

options.text: People building crazy gadgets, cars, or robots from scratch.
Mind-blowing facts about space, math, or computer algorithms.
Smart home setups, tech reviews, and 'how-to-fix' tutorials.
Shark Tank pitches, startup stories, and how people got rich.

questions.scenario: Your bicycle (or scooty) is making a weird noise. What do you do?

options.text: Grab some tools and try to fix the mechanical gears/tires myself.
Deeply research the exact sound on YouTube to diagnose the core issue.
Oil the chain, check the lights, and do basic maintenance.
Take it to the mechanic, negotiate the price, and get it fixed fast.

questions.scenario: Every tech job has a boring part. Which of these would you easily tolerate?

options.text: Getting grease and cuts on your hands while assembling metal parts.
Staring at a screen for 3 hours to find one missing comma in a code.
Untangling a massive 50-meter cable and plugging things in the heat.
Calling 50 angry customers to solve their complaints.

questions.scenario: You want to buy a very expensive video game, but you don't have money. What's the plan?

options.text: Offer to repair neighbors' broken appliances for some cash.
Find a way to write a script or use points to get it at a huge discount.
Help people set up their new TVs or Wi-Fi routers for a small fee.
Buy snacks in bulk and sell them to friends at school for a profit.

questions.scenario: What is the best compliment a friend can give you?

options.text: 'You build the coolest things with your own hands.'
'You are so smart and your logic is always perfect.'
'You are so reliable, you always keep things running smoothly.'
'You are a natural leader and talk so confidently.'

Agri_Robotics_Engineer.title: Agricultural Robotics Engineer
Agri_Robotics_Engineer.primary_match_text: You are a pure creator! You love playing with hardware, motors, and physical machines. You prefer building things that actually move in the real world.
Agri_Robotics_Engineer.day_in_the_life: Designing and testing flying drones that spray water, or building automated robots that can pluck apples from trees.
Agri_Robotics_Engineer.alternative_match_text: Since you love assembling physical parts and fixing things, building agricultural drones and robots is an amazing backup path for you.
Agri_Robotics_Engineer.roadmap: Take PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Math) in 11th. Pursue a B.Tech in Mechanical, Robotics, or Mechatronics Engineering.

Agri_Data_Scientist.title: Agri-Tech AI & Data Scientist
Agri_Data_Scientist.primary_match_text: You are the brain of the operation. You love software, logic, and finding hidden patterns in large amounts of information.
Agri_Data_Scientist.day_in_the_life: Writing computer code that analyzes weather data and tells farmers exactly which day it will rain and when to plant seeds.
Agri_Data_Scientist.alternative_match_text: Because you are highly logical and love problem-solving on a screen, writing code to predict weather and crop health is a brilliant alternative.
Agri_Data_Scientist.roadmap: Take PCM or Commerce with Math/Computer Science. Pursue a B.Tech in Computer Science or a B.Sc in Data Science.

Smart_Farm_Technician.title: IoT & Smart Farm Technician
Smart_Farm_Technician.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate problem solver. You love making sure gadgets talk to each other perfectly through cables, sensors, and Wi-Fi.
Smart_Farm_Technician.day_in_the_life: Visiting high-tech greenhouses to install moisture sensors in the soil and connecting them to the farmer's mobile app.
Smart_Farm_Technician.alternative_match_text: If you love practical tech work like setting up networks and fixing connections, installing smart sensors in modern farms is a great fit.
Smart_Farm_Technician.roadmap: Take PCM in 11th. Pursue a B.Tech or Diploma in Electronics & Communication (ECE) or Internet of Things (IoT).

Agri_Tech_Entrepreneur.title: Agri-Tech Startup Founder / Sales
Agri_Tech_Entrepreneur.primary_match_text: You are street-smart and a great talker. You don't want to build the robot; you want to own the company that sells the robot to the world!
Agri_Tech_Entrepreneur.day_in_the_life: Meeting investors, explaining how your new farming app works, and marketing your tech to thousands of modern farmers.
Agri_Tech_Entrepreneur.alternative_match_text: If you love tech but prefer talking, managing money, and leading a team, starting an Agri-Tech business is a highly profitable path.
Agri_Tech_Entrepreneur.roadmap: Take Commerce or Science in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA, B.Com, or dive straight into a Tech-Entrepreneurship degree.
